phrase: two guys fight in an alley and I want to feel every punch, raw and shaky

spec.pro_term: Contact insert with a ramp on contact
spec.movement: locked and tight on the point of contact; at the frame of contact the frame kicks a hand's width in the direction of the force, then settles
spec.placement: exactly side-on to the line of the force, at chest height, 2 m away, never in front of a face

risks: Generators add a slow wind-up. Write 'the first visible motion is the action itself'.

one_line: A tight contact insert: two stunt fighters in plain dark clothes trading blows, one hard right hook lands on the jaw, exactly side-on to the line of the force, the frame kicking a hand's width with the force at the contact; 85 mm lens; night; the only light comes from sources visible in the place, each with its own colour and a short reach; large areas of true darkness between them; bleach-bypass look: high contrast, low saturation, silvery highlights, dense blacks, visible grain; slow motion on the approach, then real speed from the exact frame of contact: the reaction happens at full speed and the shot ends when the reaction ends. Avoid: real time, with slow motion only where the shot states it; no slow floating camera drift; the camera is locked or makes one decisive move with a clear end; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; real gravity and real jump height, nobody floats; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays.
prompt_block:
SHOT: Contact insert with a ramp on contact. 16:9 frame, 1.5 to 2.5 s.
SUBJECT AND ACTION: two stunt fighters in plain dark clothes trading blows, one hard right hook lands on the jaw, in a narrow brick alley at night.
CAMERA MOVE: locked and tight on the point of contact; at the frame of contact the frame kicks a hand's width in the direction of the force, then settles.
CAMERA PLACEMENT: exactly side-on to the line of the force, at chest height, 2 m away, never in front of a face.
LENS: 85 mm.
LIGHT: night; the only light comes from sources visible in the place, each with its own colour and a short reach; large areas of true darkness between them.
COLOUR: bleach-bypass look: high contrast, low saturation, silvery highlights, dense blacks, visible grain.
SPEED: slow motion on the approach, then real speed from the exact frame of contact: the reaction happens at full speed and the shot ends when the reaction ends.
RULES: State the exact number of people. Screen direction stays the same for the whole shot.
AVOID: real time, with slow motion only where the shot states it; no slow floating camera drift; the camera is locked or makes one decisive move with a clear end; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; real gravity and real jump height, nobody floats; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays; no soft even glow; one motivated light source with a real dark side; worn real textures with dust, creases and small defects, nothing plastic or perfectly clean.

COLOUR: bleach-bypass look: high contrast, low saturation, silvery highlights, dense blacks, visible grain.
MOMENT: the exact frame of contact: the moving part stopped on its target, the surface pushed in, everything sharp.
FACES: turned away from the lens, in profile, three-quarter or from behind.
AVOID: real time, with slow motion only where the shot states it; no slow floating camera drift; the camera is locked or makes one decisive move with a clear end; nobody looks into the lens; every eyeline goes to a target inside the scene; no soft even glow; one motivated light source with a real dark side; no bloom, no haze, no fog, no volumetric god rays; matte worn floor, no glossy or wet reflections; worn real textures with dust, creases and small defects, nothing plastic or perfectly clean; no over-saturated HDR look; restrained colour and true blacks; real gravity and real jump height, nobody floats.
